college-admissions.title: Personalized College Application Support
paragraphs: We offer a comprehensive range of college admissions consulting services designed to bring out the very best in each applicant. Whether you need help with a single element of your application or want end-to-end support through our Complete College Application Package, we tailor every engagement to your unique background.
Our consultants help with school selection, personal statements, the Common App, and interview preparation, including alumni and scholarship interviews.

college-transfers.title: Building Your Transfer Application
paragraphs: We work with transfer applicants from the beginning of the process through final submission. Some students need help targeting the right programs. Others need help explaining a rough start in college. We adjust our work to fit the student, the record, and the schools on the list.

Transfer admissions requires a clear story and a smart application strategy. SOS Admissions helps you articulate why you are transferring, what you have accomplished on your current path, and why you are prepared to succeed at a more competitive institution. We help students organize that narrative in a way that is easy for an admissions office to follow.

private-school-admissions.title: Support for Students and Families
paragraphs: Our private school application consultants help students and families apply to private day schools and boarding schools in the United States and Canada. Services range from comprehensive application assistance to targeted support.
Your consultant can help you develop a balanced school list and prepare student and parent essays, activity descriptions, and interviews. School selection is tailored to the student and family.

graduate-school-application.title: One-on-One Graduate Application Guidance
paragraphs: Whether you need help with your personal statement, interview preparation, school selection, or the entire application, our team provides one-on-one support customized to your background and goals. Every essay, resume, and recommendation letter we produce is built specifically around your academic and professional experience.

The Complete Graduate School Application Package gives you one-on-one guidance through every stage of the process: personal statements, resumes, recommendation letters, school selection, and interview coaching. Our graduate school consultants handle every aspect of your application, stopping just short of submitting it for you.

law-school-application.title: Complete Law School Application Support
paragraphs: The Complete Law School Application Package gives you one-on-one guidance through every stage of the process. We help you write personal statements and supplemental essays, build a strong resume, and secure effective letters of recommendation. Interview coaching is available by phone, Zoom, FaceTime, or in person by appointment. Our consultants handle every aspect of your application short of submitting it for you.

SOS Admissions works with both domestic and international law school applicants. You can use our services as a full package or purchase individual services for specific needs such as essays, resumes, and letters of recommendation. Our consultants are available by phone, Zoom, FaceTime, or in person by appointment.

mba.title: MBA and EMBA Application Support
paragraphs: We work with MBA and EMBA applicants from the United States and internationally. Services are available as a package or individually, so you can get help with one specific part of your application or the full process from start to finish.

Our Complete MBA Application Package gives you one-on-one help throughout the entire MBA or EMBA process. Our consultants help with personal statements, resumes, application essays, letters of recommendation, and individual MBA interview coaching. You remain responsible for submitting your application.

personal-statement.title: Our Personal Statement Editing Process
paragraphs: We build your essay from verified details, then shape it to fit your prompt and your target schools. The goal is a focused statement that reads cleanly and feels credible.
items: Send your materials: your existing essays, transcript, test scores, and target-school list.
Discuss your motivation: why you are pursuing this field and what you want admissions readers to understand.
Gather evidence and stories: your history, accomplishments, and turning points.
Draft, edit, and proofread: shape the essay around your strengths, experience, and preparation for the field.
Review and revise: refine the statement for your target program and finalize it for submission.

medical-school-application.title: Primary and Secondary Application Support
paragraphs: Whether you need focused assistance with interview coaching or application essays, or a complete package covering AMCAS, AACOMAS, or TMDSAS applications and supplementals, we tailor our support to your needs.

The Complete Application Package provides full-service guidance on primary and secondary applications. Your consultant helps with personal statements, resumes, reference letters, school selection, and interview preparation. You remain responsible for submitting your application.

medical-school-application.title: Real Client Case: From Medical School Rejection to Harvard-Affiliated Residency
paragraphs: One of our clients recently matched into the residency program at Massachusetts General Hospital, affiliated with Harvard University and among the most competitive programs in the country. Five years earlier, she came to us after being rejected from every medical school she applied to. With our help, she regrouped, rebuilt her application, and gained admission to medical school. When it came time to apply for residency, she returned to us for help with that process as well, and matched at MGH. Never underestimate what a strong resume, a well-written personal statement, solid references, and thorough interview preparation can accomplish.

medical-school-admissions-consulting.title: Primary and Secondary Application Support
paragraphs: Our medical school admissions consultants offer a full range of services built around your individual background and goals. Services are available individually or as a complete package, so you can get help with one part of your application or all of it.

With the Complete Medical School Application Package, you receive full-service guidance on both your primary and secondary (school-specific) applications. We handle everything short of submitting your application for you. For details, call us at 310-951-4008 or fill out the contact form and have our consultants call you.

medical-school-admissions-consulting.title: Real Client Case: From Medical School Rejection to Harvard-Affiliated Residency
paragraphs: One of our clients recently matched into the residency program at Massachusetts General Hospital, affiliated with Harvard University and among the most competitive programs in the country. Five years earlier, she came to us after being rejected from every medical school she applied to. With our help, she regrouped, rebuilt her application, and gained admission to medical school. When it came time to apply for residency, she returned to us for help with that process as well, and matched at MGH. Never underestimate what a strong resume, a well-written personal statement, solid references, and thorough interview preparation can accomplish.

medical-residency.title: Individual Services and Complete Residency Support
paragraphs: Our medical residency application consultants provide a wide range of services, each designed to highlight your individual strengths. We will work with you on a specific part of your medical residency application (interview coaching, ERAS essays, and so on), or you can purchase a complete package for help on all aspects of your application.
With the Complete Residency Application Package, you receive full-service guidance for your entire residency application. We will do everything short of submitting your residency application for you.

Residency Program List: Your medical residency application consultant will provide greater detail about the number of programs to apply to based on your grades, test scores, and professional experience.

general-nursing.title: Nursing Pathways and Interview Preparation
paragraphs: We help applicants to all types of nursing programs: BSN and MSN Programs, Accelerated Nursing Programs (ABSN), Direct-Entry MSN Programs, RN-to-BSN Programs, ASN/ADN Programs, and Post-Graduate Nursing Residencies.

Our interview preparation is built specifically for the formats nursing programs actually use. Whether your school conducts a traditional panel interview or uses the Multiple Mini Interview (MMI) format, we prepare you with targeted practice sessions and detailed feedback so you walk in confident and ready.

np-admissions.title: Presenting Your Advanced Nursing Experience
paragraphs: Our services are designed to highlight each client’s clinical experience, academic strengths, leadership, and genuine commitment to patient care. Whether you need assistance with NursingCAS applications, personal statements, program-specific supplemental essays, or interview preparation, our consultants tailor their support to your goals in becoming a Nurse Practitioner.

crna-admissions.title: CRNA Applications and Interview Preparation
paragraphs: Our consultants provide one-on-one guidance matched to your clinical background and career goals. We support every stage of the CRNA application process, including NursingCAS and individual program portals.

Our interview prep is built around both traditional and Multiple Mini Interview (MMI) formats used by CRNA programs nationwide. You will practice with realistic scenarios and receive direct feedback from consultants who know what admissions committees look for.

pa-school-admissions-consulting.title: Individualized PA Application Support
paragraphs: Our consultants provide direct, individualized guidance for every stage of the Physician Assistant application process, including expert help with the Central Application Service for Physician Assistants (CASPA). Each applicant receives a strategy built around their specific goals and background.
Our interview preparation services are specifically designed to help you master both traditional and Multiple Mini Interview (MMI) formats used by PA programs nationwide.

dental-school-application.title: Dental Applications and Interview Preparation
paragraphs: Our consultants provide personalized guidance at every stage of the dental-school application, aligning each step with your goals and background. We offer support with ADEA AADSAS for U.S. dental-school applications and ADEA CAAPID for internationally trained dentists seeking advanced standing.
Our interview preparation services are specifically designed to help you master traditional, panel, and Multiple Mini Interview (MMI) formats utilized by dental programs nationwide.

veterinary-school-admissions.title: Presenting Your Veterinary Experience
paragraphs: Our services highlight each client’s academic achievements, animal experience, veterinary shadowing hours, research background, and commitment to animal health and welfare. Whether you need assistance with VMCAS applications, personal statements, school-specific supplemental essays, or interview preparation, our consultants tailor their support to your goals in veterinary medicine.

bs-md-admissions-consulting.title: Building Your Combined Medical Program Application
paragraphs: Our services highlight each client’s academic preparation, clinical exposure, research experience, and commitment to medicine. We help with college applications, personal statements, program-specific supplemental essays, and interview preparation for combined BS/MD and BA/MD programs.

computer-science-admissions-consultant.title: Research and Technical Experience in Your Application
paragraphs: Our services highlight each client’s research experience, technical projects, and commitment to advancing computer science. We help with statements of purpose, technical project descriptions for MS programs, research proposals for PhD programs, and interview preparation.
Our interview coaching includes preparation for research discussions, technical presentations, and faculty conversations, tailored to your academic background and target programs.

psychology-counseling-admissions.title: Clinical Interests and Research Goals
paragraphs: Our services highlight each client’s clinical experience, research background, and commitment to psychology and counseling. We help with personal statements, research proposals, application systems such as PSYCAS where used by the program, and interview preparation.

Your consultant can help you consider PhD, PsyD, and master’s programs, explain your clinical interests and research goals, and prepare for research presentations, clinical interviews, and faculty meetings.

phd-application-consulting.title: Individual Attention Throughout Your Application
paragraphs: Our consultants provide individual attention throughout the graduate application process, including supplemental application essays and interview preparation for your selected schools. Call to confirm the scope and price for your doctoral applications.

international-students.title: Working with Students and Families Worldwide
paragraphs: Our approach is comprehensive, including personal, detailed, one-on-one advising from an expert American admissions consultant. Your admissions expert will be available to work with you and your family through your graduate school or college application from start to finish. Our international educational consultants use a flexible approach to accommodate different students and families from different parts of the world.

letters-of-recommendation.title: Recommender Review and Approval
paragraphs: Your reference will be given the opportunity to review the letter of recommendation before they submit it. If they have any reservations, they can request modifications to the letter of reference before signing it.

The Letters of Reference are to be read, approved, and submitted by your selected recommender. We will make the letter of recommendation 100% truthful, reflecting your true academic or work experience.
We do not use generic templates. We write every letter of recommendation or letter of reference from scratch, making use of the information you provide to personalize the letter.

college-interviews.title: How Your Interview Coaching Works
items: Send your transcript, target colleges, and application before the session.
Review the practice questions prepared for your target institutions.
Complete a mock interview, review your answers, and practice approaching unexpected questions.
Practice discussing your academic achievements, extracurricular activities, and interest in each college.
Return several days later for a follow-up mock interview.

graduate-school-interview.title: How Your Interview Coaching Works
items: Send your CV or resume, complete application and essays, and target degree and schools.
Prepare answers to the questions provided before your coaching session.
Complete a mock interview and work with your coach to strengthen your answers.
Practice explaining your academic qualifications, research experience, achievements, and intellectual curiosity.
Return several days later for a follow-up mock interview.

mba-interview.title: How Your Interview Coaching Works
items: Send your resume, MBA essays, target schools, and test scores.
Review customized practice questions for your profile and target MBA programs.
Practice your leadership examples, career goals, “Why MBA?” and “Why this school?” in a mock interview.
Refine your answers using the feedback and prepare questions to ask interviewers.
Complete a follow-up mock interview several days later.

medical-school-interview.title: How Your Interview Coaching Works
items: Send your resume or CV, complete application and essays, and target medical schools.
Review practice questions based on your profile and target schools.
Practice discussing your motivation for medicine, clinical experience, teamwork, and empathy.
Work through ethical scenarios and MMI stations when relevant to your interview format.
Complete a follow-up mock interview with timed answers and final feedback.

medical-residency-interview.title: How Your Interview Coaching Works
items: Send your resume or CV, application, essays, and target residency programs.
Review practice questions tailored to your profile and target programs.
Practice explaining your clinical experience, teamwork, specialty commitment, and program fit.
Review your answers and work on clear communication and clinical reasoning.
Complete a follow-up mock interview several days later.

home.title: Guidance Throughout Your Application
paragraphs: A dedicated consultant helps with school selection, essay writing, resume development, recommendation strategy, and interview coaching. Application essays and personal statements are customized to your academic and professional background. We also prepare clients for formats including MMI, traditional panel, and MBA case interviews.
